attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "The group-matching logic changed from exact-match filtering to only filtering when context.GroupId is non-empty, meaning shapes assigned to a specific tab/group (via OnGroup) will now render even when no group is requested (the default/root view) instead of being hidden as before, which could break tab-based admin UIs across many modules that rely on ShapeResult grouping, and this exact regression scenario isn't covered by the added tests."}
